bestaand-verticaal.label: Timber joists on masonry
bestaand-verticaal.tekst: The floors consist of timber joists. These transfer the loads through the masonry walls to the foundation.

bestaand-verticaal.label: Purlin roof and timber joists
bestaand-verticaal.tekst:
The roof is a purlin roof. The floors consist of timber joists.
These transfer the loads through the masonry walls and a loadbearing internal wall to the foundation.

bestaand-verticaal.label: Concrete floors on loadbearing walls
bestaand-verticaal.tekst: The floors are concrete floors. These transfer the loads through the loadbearing walls to the foundation.

bestaand-stabiliteit.label: Masonry walls
bestaand-stabiliteit.tekst: Stability is provided by the masonry walls.

bestaand-stabiliteit.label: Shear walls and diaphragm action
bestaand-stabiliteit.tekst: Stability is provided by the shear walls, in combination with the diaphragm action of the floors.

bestaand-fundatie.label: Unknown, presumably shallow
bestaand-fundatie.tekst: No archive information is available. The building presumably has a shallow foundation.

bestaand-fundatie.label: Shallow foundation
bestaand-fundatie.tekst: According to the archive information, the building has a shallow foundation.

bestaand-fundatie.label: Piled foundation
bestaand-fundatie.tekst: According to the archive information, the building has a piled foundation.

bestaand-beoordeling.label: No reason for doubt
bestaand-beoordeling.tekst: There is no reason to doubt the quality of construction of the existing structure.

bestaand-beoordeling.label: Assess on site
bestaand-beoordeling.tekst: The condition of the existing structure is not known. It will be assessed on site before the works start.

wijziging.label: Opening in a loadbearing wall
wijziging.tekst:
An opening is made in a loadbearing wall, with a steel portal frame.
Stability is provided by the remaining part of the wall.
Vertical loads are transferred to the existing foundation through the columns and the lower beam.

wijziging.label: Extension with timber joists
wijziging.tekst: The extension has a timber joist roof, which transfers the loads through loadbearing walls to a new shallow foundation.

belendingen.label: Not considered
belendingen.tekst: The structural influence of adjoining buildings is not considered in this calculation.

uitvoering-bestaand.label: Check dimensions
uitvoering-bestaand.tekst:
-Dimensions are based on archive documents and/or the architect's drawing.
-Dimensions must be verified on site.

uitvoering-verbouw.label: Propping at new openings
uitvoering-verbouw.tekst: -When making new openings in existing masonry, provide adequate propping to the wall and the surrounding structure.

uitvoering-verbouw.label: Demolition sequence
uitvoering-verbouw.tekst: -Remove loadbearing elements only after the new structure is in place or the load has been temporarily supported.

uitvoering-nieuwbouw.label: Shallow foundation
uitvoering-nieuwbouw.tekst:
-Shallow foundation: establish the bearing stratum during excavation.
-Have the reinforcement inspected before casting.

uitvoering-nieuwbouw.label: Piled foundation
uitvoering-nieuwbouw.tekst:
-Send the piling records and pile deviations to the structural engineer.
-Inspect the reinforcement of the foundation and of all floor pours.

trillingen.label: Floor vibrations
trillingen.tekst:
Vibration calculations are carried out for floor structures.
Vibrations are not considered further for other elements.

trillingen.label: Not considered
trillingen.tekst: Vibrations are not considered in this calculation.

vervormingen.label: Standard
vervormingen.tekst: The deformation limits below apply to this project.

montage.label: Final stage
montage.tekst: This calculation considers the structure in its final stage. The various construction stages, such as propping, are not included.

rekenprogrammatuur.label: Open CalcSheet Studio
rekenprogrammatuur.tekst: The calculations in this report were prepared with Open CalcSheet Studio.

rekenprogrammatuur.label: Open CalcSheet Studio with appendices
rekenprogrammatuur.tekst:
The calculations in this report were prepared with Open CalcSheet Studio.
Calculations made with other software are in the appendices, which state the version used.

temperatuur.label: Not applicable
temperatuur.tekst: No particular thermal actions apply to this project.

temperatuur.label: Per element
temperatuur.tekst: Thermal actions are considered for the elements concerned.

aardbeving.label: Not required
aardbeving.tekst: No seismic design situation is required.

aardbeving.label: According to the location
aardbeving.tekst: Seismic actions follow from the standard that applies at the location.

sneeuw.label: Standard
sneeuw.tekst: Snow drift and snow loads on pitched roofs are calculated for the elements concerned, where applicable.

regenwater.label: Per roof element
regenwater.tekst: Water ponding on flat roofs is calculated for the roof elements concerned.

NL.tekst: The Bbl refers to the standards; the editions are in Annex II of the Omgevingsregeling, and those count legally.
NL.opmerking: The Bbl does not designate NEN-EN 1998. NPR 9998 is limited to the north-east of the Netherlands.
NL.opmerking2: No seismic standard is designated by the Bbl; for the north-east of the Netherlands see NPR 9998.

EUROCODE.tekst: No national choices. The recommended values apply; many values, such as wind and snow, only exist in a national annex and have to be entered.

AT.normenTekst: ÖNORM EN 1990 to 1998 with ÖNORM B
AT.tekst: OIB-Richtlinie 1 refers to ÖNORM EN 1990 with ÖNORM B 1990-1 and is binding through the federal states.

AU.tekst: The ABCB publishes NCC 2025, which takes legal effect through state and territory legislation; dates differ per state.

BE.tekst: NBN states that a calculation without the ANB is not legally valid; no Belgian building decree was found.

CA.tekst: NRC publishes NBC 2025 (16th edition), a model code that only applies by law once a province or territory adopts it.

CH.tekst: SIA publishes the structural standards; their legal status has not been established. BAFU asks for building according to the applicable standards.
CH.qp0: Reference value of the velocity pressure

DE.normenTekst: DIN EN 1990 to 1998 with /NA, MVV TB 2025/1
DE.tekst: MVV TB 2025/1 is a model by DIBt that only applies once a federal state announces it. MVV TB means the edition listed there; DIN means the latest in the DIN catalogue.

DK.tekst: BR18, chapter 15, is legally binding and refers to the Eurocodes with DK NA, first generation only.

ES.normenTekst: CTE DB SE, NCSE-02, Código Estructural
ES.tekst: By law CTE, NCSE-02 and the Código Estructural apply; the Código Estructural allows the Eurocodes with a national annex published by the ministry.
ES.qb: Basic value of the dynamic pressure

FI.tekst: Decree 477/2014: the Eurocodes with the national choices of the ministry of the environment comply; other methods may be used if they meet the same requirements.
FI.opmerking2: Seismic design only at the request of the client, according to the concrete guidance of the ministry.

FR.normenTekst: NF EN 1990 to 1998 with national annexes
FR.tekst: AFNOR describes the Eurocodes as voluntary; only the seismic part is designated by law (arrêté of 22-10-2010, which names NF EN 1998-1/NA 2007-12).

GB.normenTekst: BS EN 1990 to 1998 with UK National Annexes
GB.tekst: Approved Document A (England) names BS EN with the UK NA as practical guidance and allows other routes. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland have not been checked.

IE.normenTekst: I.S. EN 1990 to 1997 with Irish National Annexes
IE.tekst: Technical Guidance Document A (2012) names the Eurocodes with the Irish NA as practical guidance for Part A.
IE.opmerking2: NSAI classifies all of Ireland as very low seismicity (foreword to I.S. EN 1998-5).

IN.tekst: BIS calls the National Building Code a model code for governments and local bodies; how binding it is depends on local bye-laws. Its successor is SP 7:2026, whose references have not been read.
IN.tekst2: The BIS list shows 2016, while another BIS record has a 2025 edition with the same title; which one applies is to be confirmed.
IN.Z: Zone factor of the seismic zone

IT.tekst: By law NTC 2018 and Circolare n. 7/2019 apply; the Eurocodes with Appendici Nazionali only count as documents of proven validity (chapters 1 and 12).
IT.vb0: Basic reference velocity at sea level
IT.qsk: Reference value of the ground snow load

NO.tekst: TEK17 § 10-2 is legally binding: the Eurocodes with NA comply, alternatives must be shown to be equivalent.

NZ.tekst: MBIE manages the statutory Building Code; B1/VM1, second edition (28-07-2025), is one way to show compliance. TS 1170.5:2025 is an alternative route, NZS 1170.5:2004 stays the cited standard.

PL.tekst: § 204 of the Warunki techniczne is legally binding: safety is ensured by complying with the Polish Standards for design. The latest consolidation has not been checked.
PL.opmerking: Original language version; no national annex in the list of PKN.
PL.opmerking2: PKN reports no translation because of the aseismic location of Poland.

SE.tekst: By law BFS 2024:6 applies (since 01-07-2025, replacing EKS); the Eurocodes with the Swedish NA are a recognised route through its general advice. Boverket's own values come first.
SE.opmerking: Exists, but is not in the list of BFS 2024:6.
SE.opmerking2: BFS 2024:6 names no quantity for seismic actions; the status of Eurocode 8 in Sweden has not been established.

US.tekst: ICC publishes the IBC 2024, which only applies once a state or municipality adopts it. Editions differ per state, and some states have no statewide IBC.
